text: What does minimizing a failing input accomplish?
choices: It makes the program run faster
The smallest input that still fails is usually close to self-explaining
It removes the need for a debugger
It proves the bug is not in the input
explanation: A bug needing ten thousand records is mysterious; the same bug reduced to two records, one with an empty name field, nearly explains itself. It is also what turns a bug into something you can report to someone else, which is why a minimal reproducing case is respected — it has done most of the diagnostic work.
